title: Quiz challenge (beat the clock)
summary: A timed quiz short: the same few answers wait at the bottom as bins, each round a card drops in, a ring counts down 3-2-1, the right bin lights up with a chime and the card falls into it; the end recaps the answers and asks for the viewer's score. Built for comments, rewatches and saves.
needs: Questions with checked answers (and optional hints and reasons) in the brief
techniques: musical beat grid shared with the music bed
gallery_share: Guess-the-answer and 'only 1% get this right' quizzes are a staple of language-learning, trivia and education accounts on Shorts, Reels and TikTok.
limits: Every round shares one set of 2-4 answers; per-question answer sets are not supported
The template has exactly five rounds; the recipe takes one to six
Answers are only as right as the brief: a person must check them (answer_accuracy gate)
A 3B local writer fills the five-round template only for simple briefs (2-3 of 5 bench briefs); use an agent over MCP, a larger writer or a hand-filled job
Latin scripts set best; one typeface (Inter or the system sans)
